title: The human voice as the greatest instrument
summary: Randolph argues instruments should play as one sings and that the voice is God's instrument, which is why singers earn more.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young

blocks.x: Of course, the only instrument that can produce most vocal tone is the violin, and we know that. That's the closest instrument to the voice.
But the greatest -- the greatest -- you know what the greatest instrument is, don't you?

All the rest of his instruments are mechanical. They're man-made instruments. That's why singers get more money than players, I guess. Well, they give Nat King Cole $25,000.00 to do just a tune, 'Blue Gardenia'.
That's an interesting theory. I never thought of it that way.
If you stop to look at it now, this is God's instrument. This is the greatest instrument in the world.
And everybody's got it, because God made this. Now, he made these, not directly -- he made man and

But, now, man can't make nothing over God. You better believe that. Of course, we don't we're gonna get into that religious thing. But that's really true. You can put that down and rest on that. That's authentic. That's God's made instrument.
